### [`title_logo_letters`](../../../../src/title/logo_letters.asm#L6) `$84E3-$8510`

*data*

First screen code of the 2x2 logo letter at each column, 0 = no letter. The letters spell HOVER BOVVER: H $40, O $44, V $48, E $4c, R $50, B $54.

- **Read by:** [`title_draw_logo_letter`](title_logo.md#title_draw_logo_letter)
